text: This guide covers release train ARX-77. ARX-77 is an internal tracking code and is not a firmware version.
Error 0x1F means SYS_FAN1 stalled. Reseat SYS_FAN1 and ask the BMC to refresh sensors. If the SEL records 0x1F again after the reseat, replace FRU FRU-FAN-220.
POST code 0xD4 means DIMM training failed on CPU0_DIMM_A1. Reseat CPU0_DIMM_A1, then test the socket with one DIMM. A training failure is not fixed by reflashing the BMC.
Redfish is the HTTPS JSON management API. The service root is /redfish/v1/. The BMC requires TLS 1.2 on the Redfish port.
If the update reports NVME-05, the SMART critical warning bit is set.
